ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 70% high-intensity white pixels occupying the central lobe regions and 30% low-intensity black pixels concentrated along the periphery and central hinge.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity (black) bands along the trailing edges; high-density amorphous black mottling clusters at the peduncle intersection and scattered focal spots across the mid-ventral white field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 48 degrees relative to the medial axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of valleys is more pronounced on the right lobe distal section compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Double-convex curve originating from the median notch, tapering to sharp, slightly recurved lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of discrete dark circular spots (mottling) on the white ventral field; high-intensity yellowish-white calcified clusters (barnacles) visible on the extreme lateral tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant barnacle colonization (Coronula diadema) visible as raised, high-intensity geometric clusters along the distal margins of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A specific crescent-shaped low-intensity pigment mark located in the lower-left quadrant of the left lobe.
